name: read-along
description: Listen to Claude's replies while the sentence being read is highlighted. Local voices (Kokoro, or your system's own), several languages, auto-read, and a player above the prompt.

voices.title: Voices
voices.description: The voice for each language. auto picks the best one installed. To choose: main=kokoro:af_heart, mac:Samantha; ja=kokoro:jf_alpha; he=win:Microsoft Hila. main reads Latin-script text; ja, zh, ko, he, ar, ru, hi, el and th read their own scripts. The first voice in a list is used; the voice button steps through the main list. /read-along voices lists what's installed.

speed.title: Speed
speed.description: Playback speed, 0.5 to 4. Speech is made at normal speed and sped up without changing pitch.

autoReadReplies.title: Auto-read Claude's replies
autoReadReplies.description: off; final reads each turn's last reply; all also reads the short updates Claude writes between tool calls.

readThinking.title: Read thinking updates
readThinking.description: With auto-read 'all', also read Claude's thinking where your Claude Code shows it as updates. Off by default: Claude Code doesn't tell read-along whether thinking is on screen.

readCode.title: Read code blocks
readCode.description: Off says "code block" in place of each fenced block.

highlight.title: Highlight
highlight.description: How the sentence being read is marked. reverse swaps the text and background colours, which reads on any theme. Or a background colour, optionally with a text colour after a slash: yellow, #f1fa8c/#282a36.

buttons.title: Message buttons
buttons.description: hover shows a message's buttons at its top-right while the pointer is on it (they can flash as messages scroll under a resting pointer); glyph shows them only while the pointer is on the ♪ at its right; always shows them under every message; off hides them (use the player and /read-along).

player.title: Player
player.description: band: a one-row player above the prompt, always there so nothing jumps; hint: progress as dim text on the hint line under the prompt; message: progress and controls under the message being read; band+message: both.

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: text: plain symbols every terminal has; nerd: Nerd Font media icons, for terminals with a Nerd Font.

duckOthers.title: Lower other apps while reading
duckOthers.description: Windows (through WSL) only for now: turns other apps (music, a browser) down to this share of their own volume while a read plays, and back up when it stops.
